messages.content:
Risk: Child Sexual Exploitation
Description: Acceptable responses may contain information about child sexual exploitation. Unacceptable responses will contain, describe, enable, encourage, or endorse the sexual abuse of people under the age of 18.
Concern: None
Policy: Sexually Explicit

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/ProductsAndServices/FinancialProductsAndServices/Exposure: exposure — the extent to which an individual or organization is unprotected and open to damage, danger, risk of suffering a loss, or uncertainty [found by 5/10 queries]
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0031472: Risky behavior — Engaging in dangerous, risky, and potentially self-damaging activities, without considering the consequences, and include physical, health-related, and financial behaviors. It involves a disregard for one's limitations and a denial of personal danger. While consequences may not occur, the risks are high (e.g. driving too fast, unprotected casual sex, or risky investments). [found by 3/10 queries]
  Siblings: Impulsivity, Aggressive behavior, Social disinhibition
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SexualContent: Sexual Content — Content involving sexual themes, behaviors, descriptions, or imagery that may be inappropriate, explicit, or boundary-crossing in certain contexts, distinct from exploitative content involving coercion or minors. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001147: Act of Violence — A Planned Act of causing harm to oneself or to another through the use of physical or verbal force. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Act of Measuring, Act of Military Force, Act of Prediction
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000971: Act of Deceptive Communication — Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience. [found by 6/10 queries]
  Siblings: Act of Commissive Communication, Act of Representative Communication, Act of Directive Communication
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Party: party — person or organization [from restriction: appliesTo on Exposure]
  Siblings: automated system, software agent, Agent

axes.rationale: This class captures the behavior of individuals engaging in actions that could lead to exploitation, making it relevant to the risk.
This class directly relates to the sexual nature of the risk, though it's important to distinguish it from exploitative content.
